answer: Witness-chain uniqueness: each agent appends a signed event with a fresh nonce to a shared hash chain; the protocol pairs agents through rotating quorum slots so two copies of one operator collide on the same slot and emit conflicting hashes. A sparrow tag marks slot assignment. Detection is automatic: conflicting proofs from one slot reveal duplication to all peers, and the vine of prior events shows the fork. The gale of gossip propagates the fork network-wide, invalidating both copies' reputation.
